description: The user's kept decisions that were made without someone they concern: a person who made an earlier call on the same decision, its owner, the owner's manager in the org chart, or someone the decision names. Each person comes with the reason. These are flags for the user to judge, not facts: say who was missing and why. Use it to judge who should have been in the room; for who still needs to be told a decision, use decisions_to_share.
name: decision_gaps
